answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 5947 Country: India Title: Can we eat the food items given in temples? Question: Can we eat the food items given in temples? Answer ID: 5947 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 454/454=M/1429) It is unlawful and haram to eat if it is surely known that the items were offered to their gods and goddesses or the items are impure. However, a Muslim should avoid going into temples. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
